name: cinema-scroller
description: 电影感长滚动叙事排版
interaction: As the user scrolls, cinematic scene transitions unfold—parallax-driven backgrounds shift between acts, dialogue cards fade in with typewriter precision, and full-bleed imagery dissolves like reel-to-reel cuts. A persistent progress bar styled as a filmstrip tracks the reader's position through the narrative, while scroll velocity triggers subtle film grain and letterbox effects that intensify during dramatic moments.
